language_notes: European Portuguese (Mozambique variant). Vocabulary: marcação, telemóvel, ecrã, ficheiro, definições, guardar, remarcar, a seguir, precisa de atenção, meticais (MT).

branding.branding_rule: Product name 'BarberOS' must always be displayed prominently (font-weight 600-700, text-hi), paired with 'by Oryon' in light weight (font-weight 300, opacity 0.60, text-mid) beside or beneath it.

tokens.body_background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 100%, #1a102f 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(90% 60% at 15% 0%, rgba(157,123,245,.10) 0%, transparent 55%), #000; background-attachment: fixed;

rules.forbidden_casing: NO uppercase spaced labels like 'S E R V I Ç O S'. Use natural sentence case everywhere.
rules.forbidden_decorations: NO '01/02/03' step numbering decoration. NO single title word in a different color. NO '→' glued to button text.
rules.sentence_case_everywhere: All headers, titles, tabs, buttons, and labels must strictly use sentence case (e.g., 'Resumo da marcação', 'Painel de controlo', 'Definições do perfil').

glass_system.depth_philosophy: Depth is achieved purely via diffuse purple glowing shadows (0 24px 60px -20px rgba(80,40,160,.45)), subtle specular top-left border highlights, and dark translucent surfaces. Never rely on black box-shadows.

shapes_and_geometry.active_nav_item: SOLID lilac superellipse (background: var(--accent-soft); text & icon color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 600)

motion.inactive_icon_hover: opacity: 0.55 → 1, color: var(--text-lo) → var(--accent-soft), duration: 160ms ease-out
motion.skeleton_aurora: 3.2s infinite keyframe aurora animation: opacity .35 → .7, translateX -12% → 12%

mobile_dock.style: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[var(--surface-2)] rounded-full border border-white/10 p-2 flex justify-around items-center shadow-[0_16px_40px_-10px_rgba(80,40,160,0.5)]
mobile_dock.layout_id_sharing: Shares nav active layoutId 'nav-active' with desktop sidebar

public_booking.goal: Clients book haircut in <40s without account creation
sections: Cover image with dark violet radial overlay
Barbershop header: glass logo, status chip ('Aberto' / 'Fechado' live status), address, rating
Haircut catalogue carousel (3:4 photo aspect ratio)
Services list with prices formatted as '1 200 MT' (meticais)
Barbers list with avatar, specialty, and star rating
Sticky mobile bottom bar with prominent 'Marcar corte' button

booking_wizard_6_steps.progress: 2px solid lilac progress line at top of step card
booking_wizard_6_steps.summary_bar: Fixed bottom glass summary bar showing selected service, barber, date/time, and price with 'Continuar' action
steps: Step 2: Escolher barbeiro (or qualquer barbeiro disponível)
Step 3: Escolher data e hora (interactive slot grid staggered)
Step 4: Dados do cliente (Nome, Telemóvel sem registo)
Step 6: Sucesso com código da marcação e botão 'Guardar no telemóvel'

sections: Dashboard overview: 4 KPI cards with big numbers (Ex: 48 Marcações hoje, 34 200 MT Faturação, 94% Ocupação, 4.9 Avaliação), 'A seguir' queue card, and 'Precisa de atenção' card
Agenda timeline: multi-column view per barber, red/lilac current-time indicator line, appointment blocks with 3px left status bar color
Appointments table: full filter, search, status change, cancel/reschedule actions
Clients CRM: client history, total spend in MT, frequency, notes
Services manager: category, duration, price in MT, drag-to-reorder
Haircut catalogue manager: upload photo, title, recommended hair type
Barbers roster: shift schedules, commission rate, status toggle
Waitlist manager: quick add client, notification status
Reviews section: client feedback, average score, reply action
Reports & Analytics: revenue graphs, top services, peak hours
Settings: 9-step onboarding checklist, QR Code poster generator, link sharing, and 10 visual theme thumbnails

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: Every single interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, modal triggers, status badges, table rows, navigation links) MUST include a readable, role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='booking-wizard-next-btn', data-testid='sidebar-nav-agenda'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All text must be legible against glass backgrounds (minimum 4.5:1 ratio). Body text text-mid (#9b95a8) and text-hi (#ffffff) strictly used. Never place text-lo (#5c5765) on body text.
